vocab.simpleZh: 表示结果，相当于 as a result。
vocab.exampleEn: Many people work long hours; consequently, they have less time for exercise.
vocab.exampleZh: 许多人工作时间很长，因此他们锻炼的时间更少。
vocab.upgradeEn: Use consequently to link a cause to a formal result.
vocab.upgradeZh: consequently 用来把原因和正式结果连起来。
